text_block_list.text:
During a break in summer training camp, as 
I was working inside the camp lodge...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for your hard work~. 
Were you reviewing the training menu?
choice_data_list:
What matters is whether you can make it 
through the summer

What matters is whether you can make it 
through the summer, you know

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thank you for your thoughtful 
consideration.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, are you well-hydrated? If you'd like, 
how about some sweetened barley tea?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
At first, I was surprised too, thinking, 
"Sugar in barley tea?"... but it's 
actually quite delightful~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let's drink some tea and take a breather 
togetherâ

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"A breather?! I won't let you! Take! A 
single! Ooooone!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass, let's settlllle thiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... El. What's gotten into you all 
of a sudden~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The scorching sun burns El's heart with 
fiery passion! The glistening sand! The 
crashing waves! They are calling for me, 
yeeees!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...In short, you're all pumped up from 
the training camp, so you want me to help 
you blow off some steam~?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: One could say that as well, YES!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And so, Grass, a match! Please, let's have 
a match~~~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, putting me on the spot like this is a 
bit...

Grass Wonder lets out a wry smile, but 
this is a showdown with a rival she's 
scheduled to clash with in the Japan Cup 
as well...

There might actually be a lot to gain from 
this. And so—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Is that the one where you try to capture 
the flag planted on a sand mound~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The king of beach sports! That sounds 
splendid! Let's do it, let's do it, let's 
do it right away!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Geez, El. Always acting on your own like 
that...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, Grass, are you fleeing in the 
face of the enemy?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well, Grass is quite laid-back, yes~? 
Can't blame her for wanting to run away 
before the fight even starts, though!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I'm not gonna get mad over 
such obvious bait.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"I'll indulge you for just one match. Make 
sure that satisfies you, okay~?"

And so began the sudden-death beach flags 
showdown—
(Bzz-bzz-bzzt!!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaaat?! S-So fast...!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Did we never talk about this?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I've dabbled in Iaido in the past. So I 
have a tiny bit of confidence when it 
comes to split-second showdowns♪

In the end, Grass Wonder continued to 
smilingly accept the endless rematches 
demanded by El Condor Pasa afterward.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well... is it like intentionally staying 
in a hot room and eating hot pot dishes~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Trainer-san, that's too 
much-dees.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Did you not know? Grass may look fine, but 
she really can't handle the heat, you see!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever the nights get really hot and 
humid, sometiiimes when I'm asleep, my 
tummy—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Que!? ...O-Oh my~. Did the temperature 
drop suddenly, yes!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Thank you very much for 
proposing such a wonderful match, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still, we are Umamusume. If it's a match, 
we settle it on our own two feet. Which 
means—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Shall we go for a run, El? ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll let you let off... plenty of steam.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaaaaah!!

...Regardless, the experience of running 
so extensively alongside El Condor Pasa 
was sure to bear plenty of fruit for Grass 
Wonder.
And that night. As I passed by the beach—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uggh. I went too wild during the day... I 
have a feeling my muscles will be very 
sore, yes...
choice_data_list: Good work today, El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, Grass's Trainer-san! ¡Buenas noches!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the fun suggestion for lunch! 
It really helped blow off some steam, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...I may have let off a bit too much 
steam, so I'm somewhat parched.
choice_data_list: So you're close with Grass, huh?
So you're close with Grass, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Did it look that way to you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Still. When I first met Grass—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"What a boring-looking girl!" ...is what I 
used to think, you see!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It was during the Tracen Academy entrance 
exam.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
After having my physical capabilities 
evaluated, I'm supposed to run a race...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I was... just utterly bored.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(Mmh. Even if this is just an entrance 
exam... is this all Tracen Academy has to 
offer, *desu ka*?)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(I was hoping for more of that... Passion! 
Clash! Explosion!! ...sort of feeling, 
though~)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Um. Are you El Condor Pasa-san, by any 
chance?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué? Ah, yes!! That's right, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"I have been placed in the same race group 
as you. My name is Grass Wonder."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
" 'Even brushing past someone is karma 
from a past life.' Let us make this a 
fruitful race for both of us~."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Haa, 'ello there...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Don't you just think, "Wait, that's it?!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because it's before the race, before the 
race! And our whole lives and pass/fail 
are riding on it!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And yet, you just stand there with a 
fluffy smile. Without showing an ounce of 
fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I was completely let down, tripped up, 
and like, 'Seriously?' I thought I was 
running with someone totally boring."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Until that moment.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Take flight! Soar!! El Condor Pasa is 
taking offfff, YESSS!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at that incredibly smooth 
stride...! She was insane in the other 
tests too, but seriously, that girl's in a 
completely different league...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...It wasn't just that girl, you know?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, the one who blew everyone away in 
our group's physical fitness test was..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Kh!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Her running was different.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, her running, her spirit, her grit!! 
Everything about Grass was completely 
different!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It ended in a dead heat. She passed me, I 
passed her back, but she kept coming, and 
then...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Beneath that smiling, gentle demeanor... I 
felt for the first time her fiercely 
boiling will.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ……I was trembling.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And that made me certain!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To prove she is the "World's Strongest"— 
she knows she must defeat a fully serious 
Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll take her on head-to-head and 
overpower her at her serious, all-out, 
full-power best!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
For me to be the "World's Strongest" El 
Condor Pasa... there's no other way!!

From El Condor Pasa's eyes, I could sense 
an intense obsession directed toward Grass 
Wonder...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —That's why it has to be me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In the boiling blue upon the turf... What 
will be reflected in those eyes is, 
without a doubt...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oops. I talked a bit too much, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We can talk about the rest after the gates 
open, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well then... See you at the Japan Cup!

And with that, El Condor Pasa dashed 
gallantly away...
